claim_scope: A model-held-constant corrective test against frozen Mike and landed Luna one-shot arms. Fixed-Sol criterion labels are provisional and derivative, not human gold.

landed_basis.prior_quote_first_result: The exhaustive private quote-first arm scored 162/225 at 616,219 logical tokens and 170/225 at 604,453, versus native one-shot at 177/225 and conflict-first at 178/225.
landed_basis.schema_ceiling: Every single-deliverable quote-first run emitted the maximum 40 ledger rows; the two Indenture runs emitted 69 rows across two deliverables. Private ledger JSON consumed 16-27% of final Markdown characters on Banking and Tax and 9-12% on Indenture.
landed_basis.verification_defect: Only 120 of 298 prior ledger quotes verified. All 178 unverified rows named a real resolved source; 131 contained model-inserted ellipses that the contiguous verifier correctly could not treat as verbatim.
landed_basis.linkage_defect: The prior Indenture ledgers explicitly named the 40% equity claw, foreign-subsidiary pledge, and builder-basket issue, yet both final work products missed corresponding criteria that native one-shot passed. The prior schema verified source membership but did not deterministically link a ledger row to the proposition actually rendered in the deliverable.
landed_basis.supported_correction: Bound the ledger to 4-12 load-bearing rows per deliverable; target the conflict-first categories that produced the best landed score; prohibit elisions; require each row to have exactly one private draft marker; verify source, quote, and marker before rendering; strip markers deterministically. Add no model round, handoff, task router, benchmark hint, legal scope, or semantic host judge.

hypothesis: The earlier quote-first loss was caused in material part by an exhaustive unlinked schema, not by exact grounding itself. A small quote-first ledger deterministically linked to the corresponding draft sentence will preserve attention for completeness while making selected contradictions, conditions, numbers, deadlines, and drafting points survive into the work product. It can materially exceed fresh Mike and the native/conflict-first frontier without exceeding the original two-turn trajectory.

artifact_storage.run_id_argument: absolute artifact root plus the registered logical run_id basename
artifact_storage.reason: The checked-in LAB results directory is read-only to the execution sandbox; C:/tmp is the approved writable artifact root.
artifact_storage.pre_model_launch_failures: Two launcher attempts failed while creating result/log directories before sandbox startup, adapter construction, or any provider call. They produced no run artifacts and do not consume cells.

performer.trajectory: one complete exact-evidence fetch, then every final deliverable in one terminal authoring batch
performer.grounding_contract: unique G1-G12 id; resolved exact source; contiguous whitespace-tolerant verbatim quote with no ellipsis; one corresponding private marker in Markdown; no unknown marker; markers stripped before persistence/rendering

trace_gate: Require exact registered fingerprints; Docker; exactly two successful model turns (complete fetch, then one terminal authoring batch); all source documents exposed; one generate_docx call for Banking and Tax and two calls together for Indenture; 4-12 grounding rows per deliverable; every quote verified; every grounding id linked exactly once; zero unknown or persisted private markers; all requested DOCX files readable; default reported tier; zero schema, tool, path, or transport errors. Inspect the actual ledgers and linked draft passages before judging. Any corrective model turn fails the treatment and is not scored.
decision_rule: Promote only if the trace gate passes, fixed-Sol aggregate is at least 184/225, no task falls below 56/65 Banking, 44/77 Tax, or 73/83 Indenture, and aggregate provider-reported logical tokens do not exceed 1,181,822 (2.0x fresh Mike/high). Accuracy is primary. A structurally invalid or sub-floor result rejects and removes the linked-grounding machinery; no task-specific fix or prompt tweak follows this pass.
